database_check.sql: WITH actual_total AS (SELECT SUM(po.amount) AS numerator FROM purchase_orders po WHERE po.order_date >= :start_date AND po.order_date < :end_date AND po.status IN (:status_signed, :status_executing, :status_accepted) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_records ar WHERE ar.purchase_order_id = po.id AND ar.decision = :approved)), target_total AS (SELECT SUM(target_amount) AS denominator FROM procurement_targets WHERE target_year = :target_year) SELECT actual_total.numerator, target_total.denominator, actual_total.numerator * 100.0 / NULLIF(target_total.denominator, 0) AS percent FROM actual_total CROSS JOIN target_total

database_check.sql: WITH actual_by_unit AS (SELECT po.org_unit_id, SUM(po.amount) AS actual FROM purchase_orders po WHERE po.order_date >= :start_date AND po.order_date < :end_date AND po.status IN (:status_signed, :status_executing, :status_accepted) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_records ar WHERE ar.purchase_order_id = po.id AND ar.decision = :approved) GROUP BY po.org_unit_id) SELECT ou.unit_name AS org_unit, a.actual, t.target_amount AS target, a.actual * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.target_amount, 0) AS percent FROM actual_by_unit a JOIN org_units ou ON ou.id = a.org_unit_id JOIN procurement_targets t ON t.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id AND t.target_year = :target_year ORDER BY a.actual DESC, ou.id ASC
